description: A governance WRITE on go-wemix (poa). It is a different shape from the wbft one, which is what the worklist's B item warned about: wbft's gov contracts sit at fixed genesis addresses, while wemix deploys them during the etcd/governance bootstrap, so their addresses are run-specific and the spec has to ASK the chain where staking lives before it can write to it. Staking.deposit() is payable and guarded only by nonReentrant/notRevoked -- no ballot -- so it is the poa counterpart of registering a staker on wbft. The pre-state assertion is worth as much as the write: a producer's whole stake is LOCKED at bootstrap, so availableBalanceOf starts at zero and the deposit is the only thing that can move it. One assertion is deliberately absent: a balanceOf(node1) > 1 ether check. A producer's bootstrap stake is already ~1.5e24, so it holds whether or not the deposit lands -- it reads like evidence and is not. The two availableBalanceOf reads carry the claim exactly, from zero to exactly the deposited amount, and a third that cannot fail would only dilute them.
